channel.title: Said & Checked: Georgia — AskAmerica
channel.description: What officeholders said each day from or about Georgia, and which statements government data supports, contradicts or rules out.

item.title: Said & Checked, Georgia, 2026-11-26: 1 contradicted (Donald Trump)
item.description:
False or contradicted

  • Donald Trump, President of the United States: “Reported as: Trump has consistently insisted without evidence that widespread voter fraud in the county cost him victory in the state.” Contradicted. Biden's 2020 Georgia margin was 11,779 votes in AskAmerica's state returns. Georgia's Fulton County investigation report (SEB2023-025, April 2024) and the county's Performance Review Board found no evidence of fraud that would have affected the result, and said the hand-count audit and recount confirmed it; the FBI's inquiry into the seized Fulton records and the State Election Board's effort to reopen its case remain open.
